## Tracking work item and completion target

AB#<actual-azure-id> and its URL. Replace placeholders; GitHub issue numbers and Azure IDs differ. State whether completion means documentation, develop integration, a verified deployment or a demonstrated learning exercise. Verify the native PR relation in the Azure work item's Development section. Use link-only references and check criteria before closing learning/release items.

## Problem and expected behaviour

What user or learning problem does this address? Which acceptance criteria does it satisfy?

## Change and result

What changes, and what will the caller or learner observe?

## Verification

Commands or CI links and their results. For a bug fix, include evidence that the regression test fails before the fix and passes after it.

## Release considerations

Configuration, dependency, data or deployment changes; rollback implications; anything still unverified. Write "Documentation/offline checks only" when no deployment is involved.

## Learning checkpoint

Explain this change in your own words. State which parts the coding agent helped with and which parts you personally reviewed or ran. Leave unfinished learning items unchecked.
